beats.subline: Friday, November 20, 2026 close — a steep AI-stock selloff pushed the S&P 500 and Dow into correction territory to close out Wall Street's worst week in a year and a half.
beats.body: Chip and AI stocks led a broad decline that left the S&P 500 and Dow more than 10% below their October records, meeting the technical threshold for a correction, while the Nasdaq erased its gain for the year; Nvidia dropped roughly 14% and consumer staples were the only S&P sector to rise on the day.

beats.headline: Trump-Xi-Putin summit ends with thin 'peace declaration', no word on Ukraine or Iran
beats.body: The first-ever three-way summit in Shenzhen wrapped after about 80 minutes with a joint declaration touching on UN reform, fuel supplies and reducing nuclear risk, but no binding arms agreement and no mention of the Ukraine or Iran wars; a Kremlin spokesperson said Ukraine was not even a central topic of the trilateral session, though it dominated Putin's separate talks with Trump.

beats.headline: Anthropic closes record IPO at $93.5 billion as Google, Microsoft and Nvidia join $26 billion private placement
beats.body: Anthropic said it closed its initial public offering after underwriters fully exercised their option, selling 1.127 billion Class A shares at $83 for roughly $93.5 billion in gross proceeds; a concurrent private placement sold 313 million Class N shares to seven companies, including Google, Microsoft and Nvidia, for about $26 billion, bringing the combined raise to roughly $119.5 billion.

beats.headline: Jeffery Simmons returns to practice and is expected to play Sunday; Kyler Gordon's status less certain
beats.body: Defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons was a full participant at Thursday's practice and is expected to play against the Saints after being limited earlier in the week with a knee issue, while cornerback Kyler Gordon missed his third straight practice with a shoulder injury; defensive coordinator Dennis Allen said he doesn't anticipate issues with Gordon's availability for Sunday's home game at Soldier Field.
